what: BREAKOUT-CAP-ROUND: the breakout_1 executor refused a valid $75 ticket over an 11-cent rounding overshoot, and the fix is LANDED-NOT-OBSERVED until a resize-path ticket is seen PLACED. MEASURED (GET /api/bot/prop/fills?limit=1000, all 77 rows, ids 1-77 contiguous, 2026-06-22 -> 2026-10-02): exactly 1 row lost to this reason -- id=75, ticket prop-manual-00e7ecbd6bd4 (SOLUSDT long, trend_donchian_sol_prop), skipped 2026-10-02T04:04:36Z for 'risk cap: resized (risk gate ENFORCE: ticket risk $75.11 exceeds the flat-mode cap $75.00 -- resized to the cap)'. The probe is positive-controlled: the same regex finds that row. COLLATERAL: the next signal's ticket prop-manual-d428ef87df61 (04:02:11Z) was then SUPPRESSED as a reticket ('outstanding_ticket:emitted: prop-manual-00e7ecbd6bd4'), so one skip cost two signals. ROOT CAUSE (MEASURED from the ticket's own numbers, GET /api/bot/prop/tickets): bracket_from_ticket floors qty 28.45528451 -> 28.45 lots (lot_step 0.01), which alone leaves risk at $74.99; it then rounds the stop to price_step 0.01 (118.59428571 -> 118.59), WIDENING the stop 2.63571429 -> 2.64, and recomputes risk from the typed values: 28.45 x 2.64 = $75.108 -> $75.11. The lot-step flooring was innocent; the PRICE-step rounding introduced the overshoot AFTER the size was decided, and prop_risk_gate.enforce_ticket_cap's announced resize was never applied -- the executor only appended its action to `reasons`, so `fits` went False. FIX (PR, HELD): the $-cap is applied where the SIZE is decided, cutting lots DOWN to the venue lot step against the TYPED stop distance (28.45 -> 28.40 lots, $74.98), bounded by the risk the ticket itself asked for so a genuinely over-cap ticket is still REFUSED and the size can never grow.
